meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress natural language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to save input tokens. Preserves all technical substance, code, URLs, and structure. Compressed version overwrites the original file. Human-readable backup saved as FILE.original.md. Trigger: /caveman-compress FILEPATH or "compress memory file"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把记忆文件压成精简格式,节省输入开销
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果用 AI 工具时觉得上下文太占空间、又想保留关键信息
copy.tagline_en: Compress memory files into a terse format to cut input costs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI tools and want smaller context without losing key details

howto.what: 将自然语言记忆文件（如 CLAUDE.md、待办、偏好）压缩成 caveman 格式，覆盖原文件，同时把可读备份存到备份目录。压缩时保留代码、链接、标题等结构。
howto.when: 当你说“/caveman-compress 文件路径”或要求压缩记忆文件时触发。

say.text: 压缩我的 CLAUDE.md 文件
把 todos.md 压缩成 caveman 格式
say.note: todos.md 会被压缩，原内容备份到备份目录
偏好文件被压缩，技术内容保持原样

howto.what_en: Compress natural language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format, overwriting the original. Backup saved to data dir. Preserves code, URLs, headings, and structure.
howto.when_en: Triggered by `/caveman-compress <filepath>` or when user asks to compress a memory file.

say_en.note: It will compress and overwrite CLAUDE.md
